|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E2 of [[Fanfare (Reflections III) (V)]] (version 3 of 4). The image here is the Players Committee card image of this version. The current text is [[Fanfare (Reflections III) (V) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source. Every publication that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026).
* '''Original''' ([[Fanfare (Reflections III) (V)]]): Slip in the PC's Virtual Card Master Set (Set 0), official text as of 1 August 2016<ref name="ms2016">Players Committee, Virtual Card Master Set (Set 0) PDF <code>Set-0.pdf</code>, “Official text as of August 1, 2016” (file created 2 August 2016), page 4, slip “•Fanfare (Reflections III) (V)” ([https://web.archive.org/web/20160806222234/http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-0.pdf Internet Archive copy of 6 August 2016]).</ref>: “Plays on table. Cancels Order To Engage and Scramble. Once per game, may ▲ an Immediate Effect. While opponent occupies no battleground systems, Staging Areas is suspended. “Missing” on Lost In The Wilderness is treated as “landspeed = 0 for remainder of turn.”” Printed: a partial slip (the “DEFENSIVE SHIELD” band and the game-text box only), to be laid over the Decipher card; lower-left name “•Fanfare”; no errata mark. The PC first released this card with [[Virtual Set 0]] / [[Virtual Set D]] on 24 September 2014; the slips of that first release do not survive in the Internet Archive, so this sheet is the earliest surviving text. The PC re-issued the PDF on 30 May 2017 with this slip unchanged (pixel-identical)<ref name="ms2017">The same PDF re-issued by the PC (file created 30 May 2017), page 2 ([https://web.archive.org/web/20170704234722/http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-0.pdf Internet Archive copy of 4 July 2017]).</ref>.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Fanfare (Reflections III) (V) (Errata)]]): Card image published 8 July 2018<ref name="v1-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/022435b/Images-HT/starwars/ResetDS-Dark/large/fanfare.gif fanfare.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b 022435b] (8 July 2018, “Set 9 load”).</ref>: “Plays on table. Cancels Order To Engage and Scramble. Once per game, may ▲ an Immediate Effect. While opponent occupies no battleground systems, Staging Areas is suspended. “Missing” on Lost In The Wilderness is treated as “landspeed = 0 for remainder of turn.”” Printed: no errata mark; lower-left name “•Fanfare”. The PC first released this shield with [[Virtual Set 0]] / [[Virtual Set D]] on 24 September 2014. The PC's Holotable image set starts on 8 July 2018, so this is the earliest surviving PC card image; whether the 2014 release slip had the same words is not shown by it. '''Errata mark:''' this image prints no errata mark but is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026). '''What changed:''' Same words as the slip above. This is the first PC card image of the card (the PC's Holotable image set starts on 8 July 2018): the whole card is drawn, with frame, picture and icons, instead of a print-and-cut slip. A visibly different publication, so a version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026).
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): Card image published 14 May 2020<ref name="v2-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/b2c2653/Images-HT/starwars/ResetDS-Dark/large/fanfare.gif fanfare.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/b2c2653 b2c2653] (14 May 2020, “Fix fanfare (V) shield images”).</ref>: “Plays on table. Ice Storm, Lost In The Wilderness, Order To Engage, Sandwhirl, and Scramble are canceled. Once per game, may ▲ an Immediate Effect. Unless opponent occupies a battleground system, Staging Areas is suspended.” Printed: marked “E”; lower-left name “Fanfare”. '''Errata mark:''' this image prints “E” but is errata 2 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026). '''What changed:''' PC errata (image marked “E”; commit “Fix fanfare (V) shield images”): Ice Storm, Lost In The Wilderness, Order To Engage, Sandwhirl and Scramble are now canceled; the “Missing” sentence is removed; “While opponent occupies no battleground systems” becomes “Unless opponent occupies a battleground system”. The lower-left name is now just “Fanfare” (no bullet, no “(V)”), and the image is re-made at a larger size. The Episode I icon is added at the upper right, below the Reflections III icon. On this date the PC gave the Tatooine-base and Reflections III-base files the same image (one file, byte-identical); it was published again unchanged on 12 July 2020 (“March Errata Images”).
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Fanfare (Reflections III) (V) (Errata 3)]]): Card image published 31 July 2022<ref name="v3-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/ab74419/Images-HT/starwars/ResetDS-Dark/large/fanfare.gif fanfare.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/ab74419 ab74419] (31 July 2022, “updated hires gifs”); high-resolution image <code>ResetDS-Dark/hires/fanfare.png</code>, commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/594c3a0 594c3a0] (31 July 2022, “Set 0 Hi Res”).</ref>: “Plays on table. Ice Storm, Lost In The Wilderness, Order To Engage, Sandwhirl, and Scramble are canceled. Once per game, may ▲ an Immediate Effect. Unless opponent occupies a battleground system, Staging Areas is suspended.” Printed: marked “E1”; lower-left name “Fanfare (Reflections III)”. '''Errata mark:''' this image prints “E1” but is errata 3 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026). '''What changed:''' re-rendered by the PC in its high-resolution card style (new frame, colours and typesetting); same words. The lower-left name now reads “Fanfare (Reflections III)” and the errata mark is printed as “E1”.
